# ⛏️ MineForge Studio

**Minecraft Java mods & shaders, generated by AI — straight into your folders.**

Bring your own AI (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, **9Router**, Ollama/LM Studio or any local server), pick a model, connect a folder — and watch it generate **CurseForge-grade mod projects, instant datapacks and shader packs** while you follow every thought, file write and diff live. Ships as a Windows desktop app (Electron).

---

## ✨ Features

**🎛 Studio**
- 4 generation modes: **Single-File Mod ⚡ · Instant Datapack 📦 · Mod Project 🧱 · Shader Pack ✨**
- Real context window — see exactly what the AI receives, exclude messages, tune the window (auto-expands to the model's detected context length)
- Streaming replies with file cards, copy/download/zip actions, save directly into connected folders

**🤖 Your AI, your keys**
- OpenAI-compatible (`/chat/completions`), Anthropic-compatible (`/v1/messages`) and key-less **Local AI**
- One-click **[9Router](https://github.com/decolua/9router)** preset (`localhost:20128`) — one endpoint for 60+ providers with automatic fallback
- Auto-detected **context windows** shown as `128k ctx` badges; the input window + output budget are sized automatically
- Model **search** + auto-fetch of the full model list

**🧠 Live transparency (Cline-style)**
- Collapsible **💭 Thinking** blocks — reasoning and working narration stream live
- Every operation inline in the chat: `created / edited / overwrote / deleted` cards with a **colored unified diff of the exact lines changed** (line-number gutter)
- Click any row to expand full detail — file contents, compiler output, MCP results

**🛠️ The AI manages your project folder**
- Built-in file tools: `list · read · write · edit · delete` — path-sandboxed to the project root
- **Automatic faulty-script self-check**: strict JSON, brace/paren balance with line numbers, unterminated strings/comments, merge-conflict markers, empty files + `pack.mcmeta` / `fabric.mod.json` validation — problems are **repaired automatically** before you see them
- **`build_mod_project`**: the AI runs `gradlew build` itself, reads the compiler errors and fixes them until green
- One-click **Build .jar** button in Projects → `build/libs/*.jar` ready for `.minecraft/mods` or a CurseForge profile
- MCP support — plug in any Model Context Protocol server for extra tools

**📦 Desktop app**
- Electron wrapper: native folder picker, direct file writes, no browser permissions
- First-run database bootstrap, single-instance lock, bundled Next.js standalone server (no Node.js needed on user machines)

## 🚀 Quick start (development)

```bash
git clone <your-repo-url>
cd mineforge-studio
npm install
npx prisma generate
npx prisma db push          # create the local SQLite database
cp .env.example .env        # Windows: copy .env.example .env
npm run dev                 # http://localhost:3000
```

Optional offline demo (no keys required):

```bash
cd mini-services/mock-llm   && npm i && npm start   # fake OpenAI API on :3030
cd mini-services/mcp-demo   && npm i && npm start   # demo MCP server on :3031
```

Then in the app: **AI Models → Try demo** (key-less local provider) and **MCP Tools → Try demo**.

## 📦 Build the Windows .exe

```bash
npm run dist:win
```

This runs, in order:

1. `npm run build` — `next build` + copy `static`/`public` into `.next/standalone`
2. `npm run db:template` — empty schema-only SQLite template shipped into the installer
3. `electron-builder --win` — NSIS installer + portable exe in **`electron/release/`**

| Artifact | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `MineForge Studio Setup 1.0.0.exe` | NSIS installer (desktop shortcut, uninstaller) |
| `win-unpacked\MineForge Studio.exe` | Portable build |

> Windows SmartScreen warns on first run (unsigned) — *More info → Run anyway*. See [`electron/README.md`](electron/README.md) for details, troubleshooting and the IPC security model.

## 🔌 9Router

Point the app at [9Router](https://github.com/decolua/9router) and get every model it routes behind one endpoint:

```bash
npm install -g 9router
9router                       # dashboard on http://localhost:20128
```

In the app: **AI Models → 9Router** (pre-filled `http://localhost:20128/v1`, no key needed) → **Test / fetch models** → every routed model appears with its context window.

## 🏗 Architecture

```
src/
├─ app/api/           REST + SSE endpoints (chat agent loop, providers, projects,
│                     sessions, MCP, build)
├─ components/
│  ├─ mineforge/      UI (studio, activity view + diffs, providers, projects,
│  │                  MCP, context panel, model picker with search)
│  └─ ui/             shadcn/ui primitives
├─ lib/
│  ├─ server/         llm.ts (streaming + tool loop), file-tools (sandbox + gradle),
│  │                  verify (self-check), mcp-client, context builder
│  ├─ activity.ts     thinking/file-diff/check entries (persisted, stripped from context)
│  └─ parse-files.ts  fence parser with parity guard (path="..." file blocks)
electron/             desktop shell (main, preload, builder config)
prisma/               SQLite schema (providers, projects, sessions, MCP servers)
mini-services/        offline mock LLM + demo MCP server
smoke/                E2E tests (fake LLM → scenarios A–F, 31 checks)
```

- **Security**: Electron runs with `contextIsolation` and no `nodeIntegration`; every file path from the renderer is resolved and verified to stay inside the user-picked folder. API keys live only in the local SQLite database and are used server-side.
- **Tests**: `node smoke/e2e.mjs` (expects the standalone server on `:3457` + `node smoke/fake-llm.mjs`).
